text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambique's Noticias newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mozambique's Deputy Planning and Finance Minister Luisa Diogo opened the thirteenth conference of the General Directors of Customs of the Portuguese Speaking Countries in Maputo on Monday.

- UN Secretary General Kofi Anan opens the summit meeting of the Organisation of African Unity in Harare with a warning that Africa must not tolerate any more coups against democratically elected governments.
